source: Read-only connected Supabase metadata audit; no customer records or secrets queried

tables.name: public.saved_builds

tables.name: public.email_delivery_log
tables.comment: Transactional email delivery audit trail. Email body content is not stored.

columns.name: shipping_weight_kg
columns.comment: Packed shipping weight used for courier rating, not bare component weight.

columns.name: checkout_stage
columns.comment: Customer-facing commerce stage before an order is confirmed and payable.

columns.name: delivery_method
columns.comment: door or pickup_point; provider-specific details remain separate.

tables.name: public.streamers
tables.comment: Curated South African Twitch creator directory. Stable identity/configuration; not live status.

tables.comment: Frequently refreshed Twitch status for curated creators. Written by trusted backend automation, publicly readable.

policies.name: Customers can view own order items
Customers read own payment events
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM payments p
  WHERE ((p.id = payment_events.payment_id) AND (p.user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

policies.name: Customers can read own quote acceptances
saved_builds_insert
policies.with_check: ((auth.uid() = user_id) AND (status = 'saved'::text) AND (quote_id IS NULL) AND (quote_requested_at IS NULL) AND (quoted_at IS NULL))

policies.name: Customers can view own service job updates
Customers can view own service jobs
Admins can read STATIC newsletter deliveries
Service role manages STATIC newsletter deliveries
Admins can read STATIC newsletter runs
Service role manages STATIC newsletter runs
Public can browse product documents
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM store_products p
  WHERE ((p.id = store_product_documents.product_id) AND (p.status = 'active'::text) AND (p.visibility = 'public'::text) AND (p.sale_mode <> 'hidden'::text))))

policies.name: Public can browse product relations
policies.using:
((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM store_products p
  WHERE ((p.id = store_product_relations.product_id) AND (p.status = 'active'::text) AND (p.visibility = 'public'::text) AND (p.sale_mode <> 'hidden'::text)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM store_products rp
  WHERE ((rp.id = store_product_relations.related_product_id) AND (rp.status = 'active'::text) AND (rp.visibility = 'public'::text) AND (rp.sale_mode <> 'hidden'::text)))))

policies.name: Public can browse supplier-backed store products
Customers view own store request items
Public can read enabled streamer status
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM streamers s
  WHERE ((s.login = streamer_status.streamer_login) AND (s.enabled = true))))
